ACME Admin: Hey, we got locked out of the console and billing page after the roles refactor yesterday. Getting 403 on both /billing and model uploads. Can someone urgent help? We have a demo in 2 hours.
Jai (Support): Sorry you're hit, grabbing details. Can you paste org id and the user email? Also any error screenshots/log snippets would help.
ACME Admin: org: org-acme-1987, user: alice@acme.com. Screenshot shows 403 Forbidden and message 'missing permission: billing.view_account'. Models call returns 403 model.accessDenied.
Jai (Support): Thanks. I'm running a quick audit log check. Hold on.
Security Audit Bot: audit.log.search results for org=org-acme-1987 between 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z and 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z:
```
[2026-03-19T02:13:22Z] role.sync.v2: removed role_binding -> subject=svc:acme-service-principal@org-acme-1987 reason="role-mapping:old_role->new_role" by=rbac-sync
[2026-03-19T02:13:23Z] role.binding.deleted subject=svc:acme-service-principal@org-acme-1987 role=old_billing_admin
```
Jai (Support): That looks suspicious — a service principal for ACME got removed by the role sync around the same time.
Maya (Security): @Jai likely cause: recent role-refactor changed canonical role names and the mapping file used by rbac-sync missed the `svc:` prefix for external service principals. Sync saw unmatched entries and removed bindings as orphaned.
Jon (Platform): I can confirm. The mapping config in s3://rbac-configs/role-mapping/2026-03-19.json had an accidental key rename. Running a status check:
```
$ rbac-sync status --org org-acme-1987 --verbose
org: org-acme-1987
service_principals: acme-service-principal (last_seen: 2026-03-18T23:58Z) -> state: ORPHANED
bindings_removed: 1
```
Samira (SRE): We should not leave service principals orphaned during a mapping change. I'll prepare a targeted reapply of the previous mapping and roll forward once we patch. @Jon can you run reapply with dry-run then apply?
Jon (Platform): Running dry-run now.
```
$ rbac-sync apply --org org-acme-1987 --from s3://rbac-configs/role-mapping/2026-03-18.json --dry-run
Would add binding: svc:acme-service-principal -> billing_admin
Would add binding: svc:acme-service-principal -> model_upload
```
RBAC Sync Bot: dry-run complete. No other diffs.
Jon (Platform): Applying now.
```
$ rbac-sync apply --org org-acme-1987 --from s3://rbac-configs/role-mapping/2026-03-18.json
Applied binding: svc:acme-service-principal -> billing_admin
Applied binding: svc:acme-service-principal -> model_upload
```
Security Audit Bot: role.binding.created events emitted for svc:acme-service-principal at 2026-03-19T02:31:10Z
Oliver (Eng): I pushed a one-line guard to the role-mapping validator to ensure `svc:` prefixes are required for service principals and added a quick unit test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac-sync/pull/1285
ACME Admin: Confirmed — Alice can access billing and models again. Thank you! :tada:
Kendra (CSD): Noted. I'll log the support ticket and notify ACME success contacts.
Maya (Security): Follow-up actions: 1) emergency revert guard already applied; 2) add integration test in CI to detect role-mapping deletions that affect active service principals; 3) create alert rule for >0 role.binding.deleted for subjects matching `svc:*` in a 5m window; 4) schedule a short postmortem and RFC for stronger role-mapping immutability.
Samira (SRE): I'll file the immediate incident: INC-2026-0319-07 and draft rollback playbook steps.
Jai (Support): Closing loop with customer and adding step-by-step to the ticket. ACME asked for a short note explaining cause and mitigation.
Maya (Security): Assigning owners: @Oliver to ship tests, @Jon to add alert, @Samira to postmortem doc, @Kendra to customer comms. Estimated ETA for full mitigations: 48 hours.
ACME Admin: Appreciate the speed. Please keep us in the loop on the postmortem.
Oliver (Eng): Logged tasks and added acceptance criteria.
RBAC Sync Bot: Alert: role-mapping validator applied (v1.0.47).
Kendra (CSD): I'll follow up with ACME with the incident summary once the postmortem is ready. :thumbsup:
Jai (Support): Marking thread resolved from support side. If anything else pops up ping here.
